items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: I'm kind of interested in looking up this music and seeing what it is. You know, I don't know too much about his music.

ctx.x: That's the impression I got, but I never did hear it and I wasn't sure if that was right.

I think his early experience when he was, what, 19 years old, of playing in Europe with the Will Marion Cook band and as a soloist in front of what to him was a real concert orchestra made a tremendous impression on him. And all during his later life, that was sort of an ideal to be a great soloist before a huge orchestra, you know. Yeah. And Will Marion Cook was one of his idols in a sense.
